'''Kiskua''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with eighteen [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region. The planet occupied the fifth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Y'Toub]], and lay on the junction of four [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] called the [[Oktos Route]], the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']], the [[Pabol Hutta/Legends|''Pabol Hutta'']], and the [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']]. The Oktos Route connected Kiskua to the planet of [[Kleeva]] while the ''Ootmian Pabol'' linked the planet to the world of [[Du Hutta]]. In addition to that, the routes of ''Pabol Hutta'' and ''Shag Pabol'' joined Kiskua with the planets of [[Hosko]] and [[Rorak 4]], respectively.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Unidentified moon of Kiskua|One]] of Kiskua's natural satellites had a stormy [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and [[Water/Legends|seas]] on its surface, and it was devoid of any life-forms until the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], when microbial life was discovered in the moon's seas.<ref name="Biogenesis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kiskua was first pictured in the entry for the planet of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in [[The Holonet]] feature of the official website for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&mdash;a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. Kiskua was depicted in a schematic of the Y'Toub system. Since its establishment in [[2008]], ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website has gone through a number of changes, resulting in the removal of some of the features and images that were originally located there, including the aforementioned schematic. Kiskua's name was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], and published on [[August 18]], [[2009]]&mdash;which placed the planet in grid square S-12. The planet was later mentioned again in ''[[Star Wars]]: The Old Republic'', in which one of its moons was used as a possible location for players to assign their companions on individual quests.
